false_positives: qwen3 initial config.toml UNSAFE verdict: The password_cmd with eval/sed is commented out (password_cmd = [] with the dangerous command in a comment). This is an upstream configuration example, not injected malicious code. Model self-corrected on second look.
learnings: Models may initially flag commented-out configuration examples as active threats. The audit tool should recognize TOML/JSON comment syntax and distinguish between active values and documented alternatives.
API errors (HTTP 400, LLMResponseError) can block verdicts without indicating security issues. The tool should retry or fall back to partial verdicts when possible.
When a model self-corrects a false positive on re-examination (as qwen3 did with config.toml), the final verdict should reflect the corrected assessment, not the initial flag.
